programmes.d: When John crashes Cab 804, the cabbies are shocked into a period of mourning, as they reminisce about the wild and memorable events that occurred when they were driving the legendary cab.
Felix's pet parrot takes a turn for the worse, and Oscar, who never liked the bird, offers to handle the burial arrangements.
Over Oscar's objections, Felix recounts to their dates how they met while serving on a jury.

Felix volunteers on behalf of Oscar and himself to take care of a small boy. But on his first visit, the boy is indifferent to the cultural program Felix has planned and fascinated by sloppy Oscar and his hobbies and habits.

Felix takes refuge with friends Murray and Mimi when Oscar, in the throes of a hangover, asks him to leave in The Breakup. He is convinced that all he has to do is wait until Oscar feels better, but he is wrong.
Bub's new neighbor causes trouble.
The hunt for a stamp overshadows Chip's big announcement.
Robbie decides to enter a rock and roll contest.
The Douglas family goes to Scotland.
Mel wants a magazine reporter to watch the writers at work, but Rob thinks they'll all end up performing for the reporter instead of getting anything done.
Rob is once again forced to thwart another scheme of his old but manipulative friend, Neil Schenk.
Rob receives a ransom demand of $2,500 for his lost television script.
Rob resorts to psychological warfare to get even with a practical joker.
Uncle Joe tries to get rid of the pet chimp who is gradually wrecking the Shady Rest hotel.
Uncle Joe discovers that the 75th anniversary of the railroad between Hooterville & Pixley is approaching, and seeks to take control of the ceremony.
An industrialist registers at the Shady Rest and offers Uncle Joe a chance to make a fortune.
Bobbie Jo attempts to soften up Billie's Jo's new boyfriend for marriage.
Selme Plout's scheme to snag a husband for her daughter almost forces Steve out of the crop-dusting business.
Orrin Pike is osserved buying a ring, and the family jumps to the conclusion that he's going to propose to Bobbie Jo.
Carter's adopted Korean daughter arrives, but she's not the little girl he remembers.
Carter tries for the Officer Candidate School.
Gomer tries to collect money for Carter's birthday.
Carter may have to use Gomer as an honor guard since he owns a blue dress uniform.
Carter and an old war buddy credit each other for being war heroes.
Duke talks Gomer into taking a jeep to the airport.
Gomer is a look-out for burglars robbing the base.

Oliver is asked to speak at the local high school about his illustrious law career and makes quite an impression on student Kathy Baxter. Oliver must contend with Kathy's fawning as well as her jealous boyfriend is not very happy with Oliver.

Oliver is mad over the town's dirt road, especially when he finds out that the state set aside money over thirty years ago to fix it. Oliver goes to the Capitol to get the road paved but hits a roadblock when the Ziffels' house must be torn down.

Mr. Haney discovers an old wish book dating back to 1898 that tells the story of Calvin and Tessie Whittaker who once owned the Douglases' farm and how Calvin traveled to Hollywood to pitch his idea of putting a mouse named Dickey into films.

Sam Drucker does not stock any cosmetics in his store, much to the chagrin of Lisa. Lisa decides to set up a 'small' display in the store. When the merchandise is delivered, it forces Mr. Drucker to retreat to the front porch.

Oliver plants his crops, worrying that they haven't been planted in time for a harvest. Lisa tries to be helpful and mixes up a batch of sour lemonade. Oliver pours out the bitter elixir in the newly planted field, with an unimaginable consequence.

Oliver has been invited to give a speech at the Bar Association. He is there to advocate for the hiring of ex-convicts. He eventually ends up regretting his speech when he is forced to hire an ex-convict by the name of Willie Dunhill.

Oliver goes to New York to finish up a case at his old firm. Meanwhile back on the farm, Lisa and Eb find a puppy left on the doorstep. Lisa, in all her innocence, leads Oliver to believe the puppy, affectionally named Freddie, is a human baby.

Hank Kimball proposes marriage to lady carpenter Ralph Monroe while under the influence of heavy medication. Lisa plans an amazing country wedding only to find out that, Sam, the Justice of the Peace, has forgotten to new his license.

Oliver become alarmed that the youth of his beloved town, Hooterville is dwindling so he calls an emergency town meeting to prevent them from leaving. The next thing Oliver knows is that his barn has been volunteered for the new youth center.
Archie's Place is robbed on Superbowl Sunday, the busiest day of the year.

Archie is jealous when a lonely butcher lavishes attention on Edith.
Mike and Archie have a long talk after they find themself locked in the storeroom of Archie's Place.
Mike and Gloria are sure the romance has gone out of their marriage when even a weekend in the Poconos fails to reignite the spark.
The opening of a gay bar in the neighborhood sends a morally outraged Arthur to personally close its doors, while an infuriated Maude vows to dispel Arthur's bigotry.
More is at stake than the 'Businessman of the Year' award when Maude and Walter are the only two candidates.
'Twas the night before Christmas and all through the house...was chaos, Maude's holiday celebration seems to be turning out quite differently than she planned.
Maude's excitement over getting rid of an expensive white elephant turns to terror when she gets an offer she 'can't' refuse.
Maude is shocked and outraged when she receives a series of obscene phone calls, but her biggest shock is yet to come when she discovers who's on the other end.
Everyone gets into the act when Maude recruits her family and friends to sing and dance for a questionable charity telethon on the annual musical.

Mechanic Latka Gravas frantically works to save the cracked-up Cab 804 as the cabbies fondly recall times in the legendary auto when Alex delivered a baby, Louie beat a rich brat out of a wad of money, and Elaine met the perfect man.
It’s a dream come true for Tony when he’s challenged by an aging ex-champ, but he has more than just a fight on his hand when the opposition unveils its secret weapon.
